---
title: "How do I display measurements across ordered time points?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I display measurements across ordered time points?

## Steps to decide and solve

Identify values and timestamps; sort by time; check for duplicate or irregular dates; connect observations only in meaningful chronological order.

## Worked example: Nile

```{r}
#| eval: false
d <- ru_data("Nile")
timeline <- ru_apply("line_chart", data=d, x="flow", time="year")
stopifnot(nrow(timeline)==nrow(d))
```

The annual Nile flow measurements form a time series. The graph shows changes between recorded years but does not identify their causes.

## Apply it to another question

```r
ru_apply("line_chart", data=your_data, x="numeric_column", time="date_column")
```

If timestamps are irregular, connecting points can hide the unequal intervals. A moving average additionally assumes a meaningful window and regular spacing.

Use `ru_plan("line_chart")` to inspect alternative routes when required information is absent or uncertain.
